subject.title: Telegram: specific forum topic becomes permanent inbound black hole after stuck-session recovery

question: Should this issue remain the separate canonical investigation for persistent post-restart Telegram forum-topic black holes, and what hard cancellation or restart boundary is acceptable before same-lane updates can drain?
rationale: The source-proven guarded-lane path overlaps the report, but the field evidence adds durable per-topic suppression after full restarts and session deletion, so automation cannot choose the recovery contract or collapse the issue into the linked PR without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep Separate Persistent Topic Investigation
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical durable-state investigation and require live or restart-replay proof before closing or folding it into another item.

options.title: Fold Into Guarded-Lane Work After Proof
options.body: Treat this as part of the guarded-lane family only if maintainers confirm the same root cause explains the restart-surviving forum-topic behavior.

options.title: Require Hard Cancellation Boundary First
options.body: Block any lane-release fix until the old handler is actually stopped, killed, or isolated by a process restart boundary before later same-lane updates drain.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Persistent Topic Investigation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical durable-state investigation and require live or restart-replay proof before closing or folding it into another item.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged forum/session routing work is the strongest owner trail for Telegram topic routing and polling-session test behavior involved in this issue.
